words.definitionEn: laws made by a government
words.exampleEn: New legislation protects consumers' online rights.
words.exampleUz: Yangi qonunchilik iste'molchilarning onlayn huquqlarini himoya qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a change made to a law or document
words.exampleEn: Parliament approved an amendment to the tax law.
words.exampleUz: Parlament soliq qonuniga o'zgartirishni ma'qulladi.

words.definitionEn: the power of a country to govern itself
words.exampleEn: The treaty respects the sovereignty of both nations.
words.exampleUz: Shartnoma ikkala davlatning suverenitetini hurmat qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to publicly support an idea or plan
words.exampleEn: Many experts advocate free school meals for children.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab mutaxassislar bolalar uchun bepul maktab ovqatini yoqlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to officially end a law or system
words.exampleEn: The country abolished visa requirements for tourists.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakat sayyohlar uchun viza talablarini bekor qildi.

words.definitionEn: the duty to explain your actions and accept responsibility
words.exampleEn: Public accountability builds trust in government.
words.exampleUz: Ochiq hisobdorlik hukumatga ishonchni mustahkamlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to officially force a rule, tax or punishment on people
words.exampleEn: The government imposed new taxes on imported cars.
words.exampleUz: Hukumat import avtomobillarga yangi soliqlar joriy qildi.

words.definitionEn: although (formal)
words.exampleEn: The reform succeeded, albeit more slowly than expected.
words.exampleUz: Islohot, kutilganidan sekinroq bo'lsa-da, muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

words.definitionEn: despite something (formal)
words.exampleEn: Notwithstanding the criticism, the project continued.
words.exampleUz: Tanqidlarga qaramay, loyiha davom etdi.

words.definitionEn: to prove a claim with evidence
words.exampleEn: You must substantiate your opinion with clear examples.
words.exampleUz: Fikringizni aniq misollar bilan asoslashingiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: showing small but important differences
words.exampleEn: The essay offers a nuanced view of social media.
words.exampleUz: Insho ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga nozik jihatlarni hisobga olgan qarashni taqdim etadi.

words.definitionEn: to prove that an idea is wrong
words.exampleEn: The scientist refuted the claims with new data.
words.exampleUz: Olim yangi ma'lumotlar bilan bu da'volarni rad etdi.

words.definitionEn: to state something firmly as true
words.exampleEn: The author asserts that technology deepens inequality.
words.exampleUz: Muallif texnologiya tengsizlikni chuqurlashtirishini qat'iy ta'kidlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to admit that something is true although you disagree
words.exampleEn: Critics concede that the policy has some benefits.
words.exampleUz: Tanqidchilar siyosatning ayrim foydali jihatlarini tan olishadi.
